Poe Ratcho is a homophone of "poraccio", dialectal form from Rome for the Italian "poveraccio", meaning "poor wretch".
A running gag about Poe, especially in poncle's social media, is about him having a bad garlic smell.
The description of the Adventure stage, Retirement, calls Poe a "malodorous hero."
His dialogue as a vendor in Adventure Mode, "Can I offer you a clove in this trying time?" is a reference to
's character Frank Reynolds in the American sitcom
The Retired Poe Ratcho skin may be a reference to the
, as they are both old men and in rocking chairs.
Poe Ratcho (in retired form) can be seen at the bottom of the animation featured in the
of the Vampire Survivors Soundtrack.

On poncle's YouTube channel, there is a series of videos starring Poe, titled Sopravvissuti ai vampiri. The videos' titles are written in Italian, which oftentimes translate to a new update, feature, release, or DLC being available. In each of those videos, there is a random character, sitting on the right, and talking with Poe, while Poe is always sitting on the left side on the table, and between the characters, there is at least one item, usually a food item, such as the
Wall Chicken or the
Cheese.
In general, Poe Ratcho is the character who appears in poncle's videos, trailers, and social media the most.
